decision: Keep dedicated kernels optional. Row mapping lowers inverse-transform stage averages, but whole-frame completion rates overlap and p1 stays near60. Small diagnostic-off FPS gain needs longer repeated acceptance.
limitations: 8/12-second short screens, not sustained gameplay or thermal acceptance
Submission and eye-completion counters are not unique optical fresh presentations
ALVR pipeline/network estimates are not optical motion-to-photon; stationary pose timing is confounded
GPU clock/load are physical-driver endpoint reads outside measurement; no continuously sampled or per-app utilization
GPU DVFS differs: row candidates end at599MHz, controls at640MHz; workload/clock effects cannot be separated
Stage averages are delayed Granite context intervals, not per-frame percentiles; preemption is included
Relative GPU fixtures do not establish arbitrary-content fidelity or in-headset quality
